philippines.description:
KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Long lines formed at gasoline stations in Koronadal City on Monday afternoon as motorists rushed to fill up their tanks ahead of Tuesday’s steep fuel price hike. Fuel companies will raise diesel prices by as much as P10.68 per liter, gasoline by up to P3.65 per liter, and kerosene by P11.77 per liter—the biggest increase among petroleum products. philippines.title: Reject broken systems – DOJ exec to future lawyers, public servants
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Despite widespread corruption allegations involving flood control projects, Justice Undersecretary Margarita Gutierrez challenged future lawyers and public servants to reject broken systems, even if they had apparently been accepted as normal, and remember that public office is a responsibility entrusted by the people. Gutierrez made her remark during her speech on July 8 at the Sine Qua Non 2026 of the De La Salle University University Student Government (DLSU-USG).
